project: Team in a Box - Agent Swarms
description: Multi-agent swarm orchestration for Team in a Box platform. Enables Opus 4.6 orchestrators to coordinate Sonnet 4.5 workers for complex task execution.

userStories.title: SwarmOrchestrator Class Skeleton
userStories.description: Create the SwarmOrchestrator class with constructor, types, and basic structure
acceptance_criteria: SwarmOrchestrator class exists in src/lib/swarm/orchestrator.ts
Types defined: SwarmConfig, SwarmAgent, SwarmTask, SwarmResult
Constructor accepts config with orchestrator model and worker model
Class has placeholder methods: addWorker(), assignTask(), getStatus()

userStories.title: Swarm Worker Management
userStories.description: Implement worker creation, registration, and status tracking
acceptance_criteria: addWorker() creates a worker with id, role, and model assignment
getWorkers() returns list of registered workers with status
removeWorker() removes a worker by id
Worker status tracks: idle, busy, error

userStories.title: Task Assignment and Message Flow
userStories.description: Implement task assignment to workers and message passing between orchestrator and workers
acceptance_criteria: assignTask() assigns a task to an idle worker
Messages array tracks all orchestrator-worker communication
Task results aggregate into a SwarmResult object
Model routing: orchestrator uses Opus, workers use Sonnet

userStories.title: Multi-Agent Chat Interface
userStories.description: Build real-time UI for viewing swarm activity, agent status, and message history
acceptance_criteria: SwarmChat page renders at /swarm-chat
Shows list of active swarms with status
Agent status cards display current work
Message log shows agent-to-agent communication
Can filter messages by agent or type
Real-time updates as swarm progresses

userStories.title: Swarm Configuration Builder
userStories.description: UI to define agent roles, capabilities, task routing rules, and model assignments
acceptance_criteria: SwarmConfig page renders at /swarm-config
Can select agents from employeeData.ts
Can assign orchestrator and worker roles
Can define capabilities and routing rules
Can save/load swarm configurations
Validation prevents invalid configs

success_criteria: All 3 stories pass validation. Can create and run a working swarm via UI.
